description: Base wallet snapshot for one address: ETH, USDC, EURC, DAI, cbBTC, WETH and VIRTUAL balances, transaction count, contract or wallet, and an OFAC sanctions check. Paid per call. Price: 3 sats or US$0.003 (USDC) per call.

pay_with.description: Optional. 'lightning' returns a BOLT11 invoice and a token instead of the x402 payment request.
